turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric as MQLs (marketing-qualified leads), so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are leads (CRM leads created, which can be filtered to the social channel) and bookings (leads that booked, also by channel); tell me if one of those is what you mean and I will query it for September 2026.
